catalog.label: Active Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Inventory value of actively moving materials, in INR.

catalog.label: Avg Inventory Value 12M (INR)
catalog.definition: Average inventory value over the trailing 12 months, in INR.

catalog.label: Consumption (qty)
catalog.definition: Net quantity consumed in the month (issues 261 minus reversals 262), summed across material groups of different units; use per-group quantities for unit-safe totals.

catalog.label: Consumption Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Value of net consumption in the month, in INR.

catalog.label: Critical Spare Availability (%)
catalog.definition: Share of critical spare lines with demand that are available, in percent.

catalog.label: Days On Hand
catalog.definition: Inventory value divided by average daily consumption value, in days.

catalog.label: Gross Inventory (qty)
catalog.definition: Gross stock quantity at month end, summed across material groups of different units; not unit-safe.

catalog.label: Gross Inventory Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Gross inventory value at month end, in INR.

catalog.label: Inventory Turnover
catalog.definition: Trailing 12-month consumption value divided by average inventory value.

catalog.label: Maintenance Consumption Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Consumption value booked to maintenance, in INR.

catalog.label: Non Moving Share (%)
catalog.definition: Non-moving value as a share of inventory value, in percent.

catalog.label: Non Moving Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Inventory value of non-moving materials, in INR.

catalog.label: Obsolete Share (%)
catalog.definition: Obsolete value as a share of inventory value, in percent.

catalog.label: Obsolete Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Inventory value of obsolete materials, in INR.

catalog.label: On Order Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Value of open purchase orders at month end, in INR.

catalog.label: Pr Count
catalog.definition: Number of purchase requisitions raised in the month.

catalog.label: Receipt Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Value of goods receipts in the month, in INR.

catalog.label: Shutdown Consumption Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Consumption value booked to planned shutdowns, in INR.

catalog.label: Slow Moving Share (%)
catalog.definition: Slow-moving value as a share of inventory value, in percent.

catalog.label: Slow Moving Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Inventory value of slow-moving materials, in INR.

catalog.label: Stockout Lines
catalog.definition: Number of stock lines at zero available quantity with demand.

catalog.label: Stock Lines
catalog.definition: Number of material stock lines held at month end.

catalog.label: 12M Consumption Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Consumption value over the trailing 12 months, in INR.

catalog.label: Unrestricted Inventory Value (INR)
catalog.definition: Value of unrestricted-use stock at month end, in INR.

catalog.label: Vital Lines With Demand
catalog.definition: Number of vital-criticality lines with demand in the trailing 12 months.
